comments.comment: These are amazing! So sweet and uniquely flavored - definitely lives up to the pineapple taste description.
Impressive berries, but they don't last long after purchase. Eat them quickly!
Used these in a dessert for my restaurant and customers went wild! Will definitely order again.
So refreshing and different from regular strawberries. My kids love them!
Great flavor, though a bit pricey. Worth it as an occasional treat.

produce.name: Heirloom Tomatoes

produce.storageInstructions: Store at room temperature, avoid refrigeration

comments.comment: Best tomatoes I've ever tasted! The Cherokee Purple has such a rich, sweet flavor.
Made the most amazing Caprese salad with these. The flavor is incomparable to grocery store tomatoes.
Love the variety in the mix. Some were slightly overripe but still delicious.

produce.name: Rainbow Swiss Chard

comments.comment: So colorful and fresh! Makes my meals look amazing and taste even better.
Great source of nutrients and stays fresh for days. I sauté it with garlic and olive oil - delicious!
This rainbow chard is exceptional - tender leaves and crisp stems. Perfect in smoothies or sautéed.
